note: Every test records what was expected, what was observed, and the evidence. A PASS without evidence is rejected by validate.py.

tests.description: Hardware baseline regression: GNSS, LBS, data bearer, camera, SD, SMS, voice all still report success after a firmware change.
steps: Flash each baseline sketch and capture the serial log
Confirm each prints its terminal success marker with real values
Confirm AT+CSQ is recorded in the same run
tests.expected_result: All seven capabilities report success with plausible values

tests.description: The project gate is proven to fail on bad state. Covers both validate.py (14 seeded violations) and secrets_scan.py (4 cases).
steps: Seed a fixture with a DONE task whose verification.status is NOT_VERIFIED
Run validate.py against the fixture
Repeat for: DONE with empty commit_sha, DONE with empty evidence, and an orphan REQ reference
tests.expected_result: validate.py exits non-zero and names the specific rule violated in each case
tests.actual_result: validate.py: correctly failed a fixture seeded with 8 deliberate violations, naming each rule, and caught 5 derived ones (missing completed_at, verified_at, invalid priority, orphan refs, PASS-without-evidence). secrets_scan.py: 4 cases all correct - (a) placeholder in the committed template PASSES, (b) real password in a tracked .h file FAILS, (c) real password in the gitignored secrets.h is correctly IGNORED, (d) real password pasted into the tracked secrets.h.example FAILS. Two scanner bugs were found and fixed by this test: it claimed to skip gitignored files but walked the filesystem instead of consulting git, and it did not scan .example templates at all.
tests.evidence: Captured runs. validate fixture: 13 errors, exit 1. Scanner: exit 1 on tracked leaks (2/4), exit 0 on placeholder template and on gitignored secrets.h. Recorded in LESSONS_LEARNED.md as L-08.

tests.description: No broker credential exists in any git-tracked file.
steps: Run the secrets scan over tracked content
Run git log -p over the file that previously held the credential
Confirm no match in any commit
tests.expected_result: Zero matches across all commits and the working tree
tests.actual_result: zero matches across working tree and full git history (66 committable files)

tests.description: Modem reaches network registration and a live data bearer within 60 s of the PWRKEY power-on sequence.
preconditions: PWRKEY pulse GPIO42 HIGH 100ms / LOW 1200ms / HIGH / 5s settle
steps: Issue AT
Poll AT+CEREG? until 0,1
Run AT+CGACT=1,1
Read AT+CGPADDR=1
tests.expected_result: +CEREG: 0,1 and +CGPADDR: 1,<non-empty ip>
tests.evidence: lbsmatrix serial capture 2026-09-29, markers MARK-BEARER-UP through MARK-CLBS-WITH-CTX8

tests.description: GNSS cold start produces a real fix with quality 1 and sats_used > 0.
preconditions: Uninterrupted power-on; do not power-cycle the GNSS engine
steps: Power on with the PWRKEY sequence
AT+CGNSSPWR=1, AT+CGNSSTST=1
Parse NMEA with TinyGPS++
Wait on a millis() deadline
tests.expected_result: Fix within a few minutes with quality 1 and sats_used > 0
tests.actual_result: Fix at LOCK t+130s sats=4 hdop=7.3; 18.480816, 73.898640, ALT 550.7m (2026-09-30 17:46 local). Prior 2026-09-29: 18.480776, 73.897998 in 69 s, 17 GPS + 10 GLONASS, C/N0 up to 73. REGRESSION 2026-09-30 18:37-18:49 local: gnss_hold control returned satsUsed=0, fix=no for the full 500 s window across runs 6, 7, 8 and 8b, while NMEA kept streaming normally (sentence counter climbing 249 to 6009) and AT+CGNSSPWR=1/AT+CGNSSTST=1 returned OK. The receiver is powered and the UART path is healthy but ZERO satellites are in view, which is an RF/sky-view signature (antenna or placement), not a firmware or engine fault. See BUG-010.
tests.evidence: gnss_hold serial captures 2026-09-29 (69s) and 2026-09-30 17:46 (/tmp/gnss-hold5.log, LOCK t+130s sats=4); GGA quality 1 confirmed. 0-sat regression same day 18:37-18:49: /tmp/gnss-hold6.log, /tmp/gnss-hold7.log, /tmp/gnss-hold8.log, /tmp/gnss-hold8b.log (mode:DIO clock div:1, GNSS-ENGINE-NO-READY, NMEA streaming, satsUsed=0 fix=no to t+500s); also /tmp/position7.log and /tmp/position10.log (searching satsInView=0 hdop=99.99).

tests.description: Cellular LBS returns a position that agrees with the independent GNSS fix.
steps: AT+SIMEI=<imei from AT+CGSN>
Confirm with AT+SIMEI?
AT+CGPADDR=1 to confirm bearer
Issue AT+CLBS=1,1 with a 150 s timeout
Compare the result against the GNSS fix
tests.expected_result: +CLBS: 0,<lon>,<lat>,<accuracy> with the position within the reported accuracy radius of the GNSS fix
tests.actual_result: 09-29: +CLBS: 0,18.481703,73.897415,550 (PASS, corroborated by GNSS 18.480776, 73.897998). 09-30: +CLBS: 10 in all tested modes (mode1-cid1, mode9-cid1, mode2-cid1, default-CID, mode4) with true cold modem power-cycle and identical 09-29 byte sequence. Modem data plane healthy (NETOPEN OK, IPADDR valid, CIPOPEN to mqtt.easyiothings.com:80 and lbs-simcom.com:3002 OK) — ret_code 10 = LBS application close (carrier/SIMCom LBS service side). RE-VERIFY 2026-10-01: rerun the unmodified lbsmatrix control; a return to +CLBS: 0 confirms a server-side outage rather than a firmware regression.
tests.evidence: lbsmatrix serial capture 2026-09-29: MARK-TRY-mode1-cid1 VERDICT => SUCCESS (+CLBS: 0). lbsmatrix 2026-09-30 (/tmp/lbsmatrix-now.log): all modes return +CLBS: 10. lbs_debug 09-30 with cold modem power-cycle (/tmp/lbs-cold.log): PWRKEY OFF/ON, byte-for-byte 09-29 flow -> +CLBS: 10 for mode1/9/2. Socket probe (/tmp/lbs-debug8/9.log): CIPOPEN to lbs-simcom.com:3002 OK, CIPOPEN to mqtt.easyiothings.com:80 OK, but AT+CLBS returns 10 even with NETOPEN active. See /tmp/lbs-cold.log, /tmp/lbsmatrix-now.log, /tmp/lbs-debug9.log.

tests.description: A telemetry payload published by the device is received by an independent MQTT subscriber on the target cluster.
preconditions: No bridge, tunnel, relay or cloudflared in the data path (ADR-004)
Independent subscriber running on the target cluster
steps: Bring the PPP data channel up (ATD*99# -> PPP RUNNING)
Open a raw lwIP TCP socket to broker.hivemq.com:1883 (DNS skipped via MQTT_HOST_IP; this carrier drops non-TCP traffic)
Send the fixed MQTT CONNECT frame (10 37 ... ) as raw bytes
Read the 4-byte CONNACK via recv() in 500ms slices while feeding the PPP UART
Publish the telemetry payload to nomadlink/one/gps
Confirm an independent subscriber receives it
tests.expected_result: Device logs MQTT-CONNECT sent, a CONNACK is parsed, and the subscriber receives the payload
tests.actual_result: MQTT over PPP verified end to end on the physical unit (firmware A7670M7_V1.11.1). CONNACK rc=0 sp=00, MARK-MQTT-CONNECTED, PUBLISH 71 bytes to nomadlink/one/gps, RESULT MQTT_PUBLISH PASS. An independent mosquitto_sub on the Mac (broker.hivemq.com:1883) received the exact JSON payload. Key fixes: UART feeder interleaved into every blocking socket wait (18.3s ENETUNREACH starvation gone; connects now ~3.2s), frame builders corrected (body must sit right after the 1-byte remaining-length field), and the CONNACK wait keeps looping in short slices instead of aborting on the first 500ms timeout.
tests.evidence: mqtt_ppp serial capture 2026-09-30: 'connect select() -> ready after 3201 ms', 'TCP to broker CONNECTED', 'CONNACK rc=0 sp=00', 'MARK-MQTT-CONNECTED', 'RESULT MQTT_PUBLISH PASS'; subscriber log: nomadlink/one/gps {\"src\":\"mqtt_ppp\",\"uptime_s\":32,\"phase\":\"RUNNING\"}

tests.description: OV2640 captures live frames with non-zero luma variance.
preconditions: Camera connected on the V1 pinout
steps: Read the sensor ID
Capture 320x240 RGB565
Compute luma mean, stddev and block stddev
tests.expected_result: Sensor ID 0x7fa2/0x0026 and non-zero variance
tests.actual_result: MID 0x7fa2, PID 0x0026, VER 0x0042. Luma mean 35.0, stddev 15.4, block stddev 9.2. Non-zero variance is what proves a live sensor; a failed init also yields a flat fill.

tests.description: Outbound SMS is received by the recipient, with delivery report enabled.
steps: Send a test SMS
Observe +CMGS

tests.expected_result: +CMGS: <ref> and the recipient confirms receipt
tests.actual_result: +CMGS: 2 and +CMGS: 3, both confirmed received by the user. Note AT+CMGL="SENT" is NOT supported (CMS ERROR: Operation not allowed), so the sent box cannot be read back.

tests.description: Outgoing voice call establishes and reaches active state.
steps: ATD<number>;
Observe +VOICE CALL: BEGIN
Poll AT+CLCC? for state 2
Hang up with AT+ATH
tests.expected_result: Call state 2 (active)
tests.actual_result: +VOICE CALL: BEGIN and +CLCC: 1,0,2 (active). User reported hearing audio. NOTE: the far-end audio path has not been separately proven and ringback must not be confused with full-duplex voice. See RISK-003.

tests.description: SD card mounts and completes a write/read/delete round trip under the product firmware framework.
steps: Mount the card
Write a test file
Read it back and compare
Delete it
tests.expected_result: Round trip succeeds
tests.actual_result: PASSES under Arduino-ESP32 3.3.11 (3,984,588,800-byte FAT32 card). FAILS under ESP-IDF with err=0x107 on every card command. The framework discrepancy is unresolved. See BUG-001 and RISK-006.

tests.description: PPP establishes and assigns an IP on the Airtel SIM.
steps: Bring up PPP over UART
Observe PPP Start/Establish/Auth/Network
Confirm LCP/IPCP negotiation
Confirm an IP is assigned
tests.expected_result: PPP establishes and an IP is assigned
tests.actual_result:
PASS. All four steps completed on the Airtel SIM.

STEP 1 PASS - data bearer up. AT+CGATT=1 -> OK. AT+CGDCONT=1,"IP","airtelgprs.com" -> OK. AT+CGACT=1,1 -> OK. AT+CGPADDR=1 -> +CGPADDR: 1,100.76.89.65 (a carrier-allocated CGNAT address).

STEP 2 PASS - PPP dial accepted. ATD*99# returned 'CONNECT'. The firmware then waits 2000 ms for the module to finish entering data mode before handing the UART to lwIP.

STEP 3 PASS - LCP and IPCP negotiated. lwIP reported the phase sequence ESTABLISH -> NETWORK -> RUNNING. The module answered lwIP's own Configure-Request (235 bytes received), proving bidirectional PPP on UART.

STEP 4 PASS - an IP was assigned. lwIP's PPP netif came up with local=100.76.140.112, gateway=10.64.64.64, mtu=1500, up=1. RUNNING was then held stable for the remainder of the capture with no reset and no retransmission. A separate cold-boot run (ESP32 reset with no USB unplug) reproduced the result with a different address, local=100.77.131.255, gateway=10.64.64.64, 230 bytes out / 273 bytes in.

RESOLUTION NOTE - the earlier 'modem latched off' blocker (BUG-005) was a misdiagnosis. The silence was never a dead modem: the module was in PPP data mode, where AT commands are discarded by design. See BUG-005 and BUG-006 for the three real defects that had prevented negotiation.
tests.evidence:
Serial console capture on /dev/cu.usbmodem58750034621, firmware/baseline/ppp_client, Arduino ESP32 core 3.3.11. Verbatim excerpts, first run:
  > ATD*99#            < CONNECT received - handing UART to PPP
  > TX frame 1 (45 bytes): 7E FF 7D 23 C0 21 7D 21 7D 21 7D 20 7D 34 7D 22 7D 26 7D 20 7D 20 7D 20 7D 20 7D 25 7D 26 CA 73 8C 9E 7D 27 7D 22 7D 28 7D 22 36 4B 7E
  > PPP phase -> ESTABLISH | NETWORK | RUNNING
  > PPP-IP  local=100.76.140.112  gateway=10.64.64.64  up=1  mtu=1500
  > RESULT PPP_NEGOTIATION PASS (phase RUNNING, 217 bytes out, 235 bytes in)
  > [link] up phase=RUNNING out=217 in=235   (repeated, stable, no reset)

Cold-boot repeat run, ESP32 reset via DTR/RTS with the USB cable untouched:
  > PPP phase -> NETWORK | RUNNING
  > PPP-IP  local=100.77.131.255  gateway=10.64.64.64  up=1  mtu=1500
  > RESULT PPP_NEGOTIATION PASS (phase RUNNING, 230 bytes out, 273 bytes in)
